parameters.content:
## BookLeaf job status
GET /webhook/royalty-summary/jobs?ids=<id>,<id>[&include=html] with header X-BookLeaf-Key (n8n Header Auth). Up to 50 ids; unknown ids come back in `missing`. Successful runs are not saved (Bubble polls every few seconds).

## Answer
One query answers the jobs, in the order asked; 503 if the database is down.

parameters.query:
WITH asked AS (
  SELECT id, ord FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'ids') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(id, ord)
), found AS (
  SELECT a.ord, to_jsonb(j) AS job FROM asked a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.job_id::text AS job_id, r.log_id, r.batch_id, r.author_id, r.author_code, r.mode, r.status, r.error_code, r.error,
      r.subject, r.sent_to, r.figures_verified, r.ai_attempts, r.provider, r.model, r.input_tokens, r.output_tokens,
      r.cost_usd::float8 AS cost_usd, r.requested_by, to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS created_at, to_char(r.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS updated_at, to_char(r.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS completed_at,
      r.callback_status, r.stage, to_char(r.stage_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS stage_at, r.delivery, r.tone, r.length, r.issues, r.edit_text, to_char(r.drafted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS drafted_at,
      r.html, r.text_body
    FROM royalty_jobs r WHERE r.job_id = a.id::uuid) j
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'jobs', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN ($1::jsonb->>'include_html')::boolean THEN job ELSE job - 'html' - 'text_body' END ORDER BY ord)
    FROM found), '[]'::jsonb),
  'missing', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.id ORDER BY a.ord) FROM asked a WHERE a.ord NOT IN (SELECT ord FROM found)), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS response

parameters.responseBody: {"error":{"code":"DB_UNAVAILABLE","message":"The job database could not be reached, so the request was not handled. Try again shortly.","retryable":true}}
